source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of modular programming (PDF 54).

blocks.text: Modular programming mein program ko chhote, sambhalne mein aasan aur dobara istemal hone wale hisson mein banta jata hai jinhein modules kehte hain. Is se programmers alag alag hisson par alag kaam kar sakte hain aur code baar baar istemal ho sakta hai. Bare aur pecheeda programs sambhalna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Python mein modular programming kyun mufeed hai, samjhaiye (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Program ko modules mein taqseem karne se har hissa chhota aur markooz rehta, kai log ek saath kaam kar sakte, code dohraya nahi jata kyunke module kahin bhi import ho sakta hai, aur ghaltiyan dhoondna aur theek karna aasan hota hai.

items: Modular programming: program ko modules mein baantna; code reuse aasan.
